import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess,pathlib,sys
p=pathlib.Path.cwd()
for n in ['forest','algebra']:
 z=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/f'sources/{n}.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert z.returncode==0
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{n}.txt'],input=z.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print('TEXT',n,len(z.stdout)); print(z.stdout[:12500])
s=pathlib.Path('sources/switching.txt').read_text();a=s.find('Definition 5.1');print('DECK TARGET',s[a:a+3200]);print('COPRIME TAIL',pathlib.Path('sources/coprime.txt').read_text()[-4500:])
